parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no facility or custody ban, foreign acceptance posture, visible community and Pride scene. But there is documented state-tolerated targeting: police abuse and extortion of trans women (forced bathing, expulsion), 38% arrest rate among surveyed trans women attributed to being trans, and 135+ harassment/abuse cases — tier-2 organised police misconduct, largely aimed at street/sex-work spheres a visitor may partially avoid but not reliably. Documented violence (>100 incidents) lacks background comparison. No published custody policy for non-surgical prisoners (open question), and UPR promises unenacted. Recourse is weak (disputed protections, thin enforcement). This sits between the 0.45 and 0.55 targets: recurring visitor-relevant police hostility with partial community infrastructure and no criminalisation, but no universal institutional exclusion.
